As per orders from the supervisor downstairs, the new Modulator has been installed. Rest assured that all necessary precautions have been taken, and it will pose no interference in the day-to-day operations of the facility. 

As with all operations downstairs, the exact nature and function of the Modulator is not your concern.

Do not attempt to interact with the Modulator for any reason. 

In the event of an anomalous incident, report to your immediate supervisor immediately and then exit the facility.

items.source_en:
Another first day of school. You are growing up so fast that it makes us sick, and by now you probably are embarrassed to be getting these letters. Have mercy on your dear old parents and read this last one, all right? 

We just want to say that we are proud of you no matter what. We know that you have had a hard time at school before. Just do your best, and if anyone is mean to you, stand up for yourself. But, dare to be kind like you always have been. That is what is so special about you.

Keep this note on you, and read it if you are ever scared or sad. You are not alone - we are always here for you, and again, we could not be more proud. 

You will change the world one day, just by being yourself.

We love you!
- Mother and Father

(By the way - you can talk to us about anything, do not forget that.)
items.legacy_ko:
새 학기 첫날이 또 시작했네. 네가 너무 빨리 자라서 우린 아플 지경이고, 지금쯤 너는 이제 이런 편지를 받는 게 부끄러울 것 같구나. 사랑하는 부모님을 불쌍히 여기고 이 마지막 편지를 읽어 주길 바란다, 알겠지?

우리는 그 무슨 일이 있어도, 널 자랑스럽게 여길 것이라고 전하고 싶었단다. 학교에서 힘든 시간을 보냈을 거라는 걸 우리도 잘 알아. 최선을 다하고, 누군가가 네게 못된 짓을 하면 스스로 맞서 싸워야 해. 하지만, 항상 그래왔던 것처럼 친절하게 행동해야 한단다. 그게 네 특별한 점이야.

이 편지를 간직하고, 두렵거나 슬플 때 읽어보도록 하렴. 넌 혼자가 아니야. 우리는 항상 널 위해 이곳에 있고, 다시 말하지만, 우리는 이보다 네가 더 자랑스러울 수가 없구나.

너는 네 스스로의 모습만으로도, 언젠가 이 세상을 바꾸게 될 거야.

우리는 널 사랑해!
- 엄마와 아빠

(그리고, 우리한테 어떤 이야기든 할 수 있단다. 잊지 마렴.)
